front.text: Dobrý deň, tri, nie dva, nie sedem, nie osem.

back.text: Good day, three, not two, not seven, not eight.
back.notes:
[tri]

tri — cardinal number 'three', nominative neuter plural; from Proto-Slavic *trьje

front.text: Nie, dobrý deň, sedem, nie tri, nie osem, nie desať.

back.text: No, good day, seven, not three, not eight, not ten.
back.notes:
[ˈsɛdɛm]

sedem — cardinal number 'seven', nominative neuter singular; from Proto-Slavic *sedmь

front.text: Dobrý deň, osem, nie sedem, nie deväť, nie desať.

back.text: Good day, eight, not seven, not nine, not ten.
back.notes:
[ˈɔsɛm]

osem — cardinal number 'eight', nominative neuter singular; from Proto-Slavic *osmь

front.text: Nie, dobrý deň, deväť, nie osem, nie desať, nie jeden.

back.text: No, good day, nine, not eight, not ten, not one.
back.notes:
[ˈdɛvæc]

deväť — cardinal number 'nine', nominative neuter singular; from Proto-Slavic *devętь, with soft ť from palatalization

front.text: Dobrý deň, desať, nie deväť, nie sedem, nie dva.

back.text: Good day, ten, not nine, not seven, not two.
back.notes:
[ˈdɛsac]

desať — cardinal number 'ten', nominative neuter singular; from Proto-Slavic *desętь, with soft ť from palatalization

front.text: Dobrý deň, jeden, dva, tri, desať, nie sedem.

back.text: Good day, one, two, three, ten, not seven.
back.notes:
[ˈdɔbriː ˈdɛɲ]

dobrý deň — set greeting phrase; dobrý = adjective 'good' nominative masculine singular, deň = noun 'day' nominative masculine singular

front.text: Nie, dobrý deň, jeden, dva, tri, desať.

back.text: No, good day, one, two, three, ten.
back.notes:
[ɲiɛ]

nie — negation particle 'no/not'; from Proto-Slavic *ne, with Slovak diphthongization of e → ie
